documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PC FR
Bambu PC FR Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724C01
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PC FR
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties; specimens printed at nozzle 270 °C, bed 100 °C, 100 mm/s, 100% infill, annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 21 ± 3 MPa, elongation 1.5 ± 0.4 %, bending modulus 1660 ± 80 MPa, bending strength 47 ± 2 MPa, impact 8.0 ± 0.4 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1670 ± 40 MPa, Z 1450 ± 60 MPa), melt index (26.4 ± 2.7 g/10 min at 260 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), heat deflection temperature 113 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.12% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 40 mm), support ("Turn on"), spool material (PC+ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing of prints (85 to 100 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability ("Flame retardant"), combustion products and their odor.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PC FR", model "C01-xx", CLP "Not classified", no PBT/vPvB substance or endocrine disruptor, IARC: no component ≥ 0.1 % identified as a carcinogen, and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI / IATA) transport; REACH SVHC "Not listed". Its section 3 prints the PC CAS number as "250-37-45-0" (as written). Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values. The ABS / ASA / PC wiki links a different "MSDS-PC FR" file (/filament-acc/abs-asa-pc/74e912f5fa17467c94e92af2ab913346.pdf) that was not cached and not read; the store-linked SDS20250724C01 was read.

Store page consistency: the parsed store page gives material.diameter 1.75 mm, material.diameter_tolerance ± 0.03 mm and material.net_weight 1000 g (option Size › 1 kg); all three agree with the TDS. Its material.density and print_settings.nozzle_temp rows are not_found and are replaced by the TDS values. The page FAQ (3.Safety Tips) states nozzle 260-280°C and bed 90-110°C in prose, which agrees with the TDS. No curated value differs from the page.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 260 - 280 °C vs material-table wiki 260 - 290 for the "PC" class row); bed temperature (TDS 90 - 110 °C vs material-table wiki 100 - 120 ℃ for "PC"); AMS HT drying time (ABS / ASA / PC wiki 80 °C × 12 h for PC FR vs drying and material-table wikis 80 °C, 8 h for "PC"; not stored, the registry has one drying key holding the TDS oven value); oven drying temperature (TDS 80 °C vs ABS / ASA / PC wiki 75 – 85 °C); AMS lite (product sources "not compatible" vs the material-table wiki's combined AMS / AMS lite column "Compatible" for "PC"); 0.2 mm nozzle (TDS lists it vs ABS / ASA / PC wiki excluding it on P2S / X2D). The product TDS and the product-specific statements are kept.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Engineering-Level Mechanical Properties", "toughness comparable to PAHT-CF", "exceptional stiffness and strength" and the UL 94 explanation text ("burning stops within 10 seconds") are not stored as values. The UL 94 V-0 claim is stored only as an unverified safety.certifications row from the store bullet.
not_published: filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched (TDS, SDS, the three wikis, the store page).
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

Not cached, so not read: the store page's "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/s1/default/8f1f399e5f7f4101980977fc59f34687.pdf) and "Filament UL 94 Test Report" (https://store.bblcdn.com/s1/default/a7ac91acf11b41bea0883615f46ed557.pdf). safety.certifications therefore stays unverified and is not marked not_published.
